name: Nåpu Brewing Co. — Tapped Out, Garapan

sources.evidence: The current official Nåpu Brewing Co. page identifies Napu Brewing Co. as a Northern Mariana Islands-based brewing company, states that it exists to brew local craft beer, and lists 923 Micro Beach Rd, Garapan, Saipan 96950, CNMI.

The current official craft-beer menu identifies eight named Nåpu Brewing Co. beers as Made in Saipan or Made in CNMI and lists the same Garapan, Saipan location, supporting current operation and concrete products.
